data.notes: July 2026 is already anchored by confirmed electronic headliners across Cavo Paradiso, Scorpios, SantAnna, and Alemagou, with more lineups likely to fill in closer to summer.

events.title: Alex Wann at Cavo Paradiso
events.summary: Alex Wann is confirmed for a late-night Cavo Paradiso show on Saturday, July 4. Resident Advisor lists the event at Cavo Paradiso with afro-house and afrobeats tags.

events.title: Max Styler at Cavo Paradiso
events.summary: Max Styler is confirmed for Cavo Paradiso on Sunday, July 5. The event is listed by Songkick at the Paradise Beach club.

events.title: James Hype at Cavo Paradiso
events.summary: Songkick’s Cavo Paradiso venue calendar confirms James Hype for Monday, July 13. It is part of the club’s July run of international electronic bookings.

events.title: WhoMadeWho at Scorpios Beach Club
events.summary: WhoMadeWho are confirmed for Scorpios Beach Club on Friday, July 17. Songkick lists the Danish electronic group as the headliner at the Paraga venue.

events.title: BLOND:ISH at Abracadabra @ Alemagou
events.summary: BLOND:ISH is confirmed for Abracadabra @ Alemagou on Saturday, July 18. Songkick lists the event as an outdoor Mykonos date at the Alemagou party concept.

events.title: Valeron at Scorpios Beach Club
events.summary: Valeron is confirmed for Scorpios Beach Club on Saturday, July 18. The booking reflects Scorpios’ signature local-electronic sunset sound.

events.title: DJ Snake at Cavo Paradiso
events.summary: DJ Snake is confirmed for Cavo Paradiso on Friday, July 24, with doors listed at 23:00. Songkick lists the event as an electronic, pop, and R&B-area concert at the Mykonos club.

events.title: The Martinez Brothers & Seth Troxler at SantAnna Mykonos
events.summary: SantAnna Mykonos and Blend Athens present The Martinez Brothers with Seth Troxler on Friday, July 24. Resident Advisor lists the event as a house-focused evening at SantAnna.

events.title: Black Coffee - The 2026 Residency at SantAnna
events.summary: Black Coffee’s SantAnna residency is confirmed for Monday, July 27, one of six listed Monday performances from mid-July through August. Resident Advisor lists Blend Athens and SantAnna Mykonos as promoters.

events.title: Timmy Trumpet at Cavo Paradiso
events.summary: Timmy Trumpet is confirmed for Cavo Paradiso on Tuesday, July 28. Songkick lists the Australian electronic artist as the headliner at the Paradise Beach venue.

events.title: Innervisions Mykonos at Scorpios
events.summary: Innervisions Mykonos is confirmed for Scorpios on Thursday, July 30. Resident Advisor lists Âme DJ, Dixon, Jimi Jules, Julya Karma, and Trikk on the lineup.

events.title: Richie Hawtin at Cavo Paradiso
events.summary: Richie Hawtin is confirmed for Cavo Paradiso on Friday, July 31. Songkick lists the techno headliner at the Mykonos club with tickets on sale.
